programme.title: Cheran Chozhan Pandian
programme.desc: After being released from jail Cheran, Chozhan, and Pandian are determined to reform, they encounter the corrupt politician Swamy. They befriend Gayathri, Swamy's sister, leading to complications.

programme.title: Pattayya Kelappannum Pandi Yaa
programme.desc: Velpandiyan, a minibus driver, falls in love with Kanmani, a regular commuter of the bus. However, they face several challenges as their relationship grows further.

programme.title: Coimbatore Mappllai
programme.desc: Balu comes to the city for better opportunities and stays with his friend. He falls in love with Sumithra, his landlord, but her evil cousin, Mahesh, creates a rift between them.

programme.title: Mariyathai
programme.desc: Annamalai is a highly respected man whose son, Raja, falls in love with Radha, a music teacher. Radha manages to manipulate Raja into giving up his property.

programme.title: Maanik
programme.desc: Maanik, a young man, tries to impress many women with his antics. Though a school teacher falls for him, the only problem is a boon that can prove hazardous to his prospective father-in-law.

programme.title: Vandi
programme.desc: Three roommates, who are trying to make their ends meet, land in trouble due to a stolen bike that has been extensively used by robbers for executing their plans

programme.title: Shakalka Baby
programme.desc: Sundaran and Pandi are married to two sisters who henpeck them and live together in the same house. When a young girl enters their house claiming to be pregnant, the men are distracted by her beauty

programme.title: Chinna Chinna Kannile
programme.desc: When Raju loses his soft-spoken, loving elder brother Balu in a fight, he gives up his violent ways. However, his life changes for the better when he meets his brother's lookalike, who is a criminal.

programme.title: Agilan
programme.desc: Madurai's ACP gets the heat from his seniors for his team's poor performance. In order to mend that, he plans a fake operation for his team. But his plan goes awry due to a meddling sub-inspector.

programme.title: Kaalatpadai
programme.desc: Sridhar fights with Ram for dating his sister. Ram and Priya get married secretly with the help of Ram's parents and friends. Ram's father advises him to find a job and then start a married life.

programme.title: Roja
programme.desc: Roja, a simple girl from a village in Tamil Nadu, makes desperate efforts to find her husband, Rishi, after he is kidnapped by militants during a secret undercover mission in Jammu and Kashmir.

programme.title: Jerry
programme.desc: Jerry, a guy with a cynical attitude towards the concept of love, is challenged by his friends to make three women fall in love with him. Jerry takes up the challenge and begins flirting with them.

programme.title: Ettu Thikkum Madha Yana
programme.desc: When his father is found dead, Natesan decides to find the culprits. While investigating, he learns that his father's death is connected to the murder of his childhood friend.

programme.title: 5 Star
programme.desc: Five college friends promise to stay together even after completing their education. However, one of them hides from the others that he has been forced to marry a village girl.

programme.title: Edhyathai Thirudathey
programme.desc: Prakash, who is diagnosed with terminal cancer, and Geethanjali, an equally ill patient, fall in love with each other. However, when she learns about his illness, she decides to move out of his life.

programme.title: Thalakonam
programme.desc: Thalakonam is ithesh in the lead role an action-drama in romatical love story movie

programme.title: Puthumai Pithan
programme.desc: Jeeva is framed and sent to a mental asylum and his family murdered when he earns the enmity of a corrupt politician. He escapes the asylum and exacts revenge on the politician who destroyed his life.

programme.title: Gummalam
programme.desc: Four friends fall in love with Rathi when she moves in into their neighbour's house. Later, the police arrest her and they all get shocked to learn about her true identity.

programme.title: Magane En Marumagan
programme.desc: Singaram, a loafer, tricks a rich man in a village and gets married to his daughter. When Singaram is accused of killing his enemy, he is forced to flee to Chennai.

programme.title: Kalai Jan
programme.desc: Pop singer Inderjeet is the main suspect after his female fans are killed by a serial killer. Divya, whose sister was a dancer in his troupe and the first target, comes to the city to find the killer.

programme.title: Dharmathin Thalaivan
programme.desc: When Raju loses his soft-spoken, loving elder brother Balu in a fight, he gives up his violent ways. However, his life changes for the better when he meets his brother's lookalike, who is a criminal.

programme.title: Acharam

programme.title: Mugamariyaan

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: With the tournament only a week away, the pressure reaches a boiling point. Arun’s father discovers he quit his job, leading to a major confrontation. Meanwhile, the team faces a crushing defeat in a practice match against established professionals, leaving their confidence shattered. However, seeing Arun's dedication eventually inspires his father to have a change of heart, and the team finally begins to gel as a unit.

programme.title: Rise Of The Underdogs
programme.desc: The season finale takes place at the Indian Pro Gaming League. Team Clutch enters as the ultimate underdogs. After a shaky start and a brief internal conflict where Raunak almost walks out, the team reunites for a final stand. They reach a thrilling tie-breaker round where they must prove their worth. The series ends with the team securing a victory, using their prize money to chase their individual dreams while planning to build a permanent gaming headquarters.

programme.title: Rangbaaji (the Carefree Persona)
programme.desc: We are introduced to Raviranjan, a small-town guy who balances life as a part-time YouTuber with his status as a "full-time" aspirant. While he acts confident (his rangbaaji), the episode reveals the underlying pressure he faces. He isn’t just seeking a job; he’s seeking the social status required to marry Jyoti. The episode sets up the stakes: it's a battle between his dreams and the harsh deadlines of the competitive exam world.

programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Humse Na Ho Paayega
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the ultimate "Generation Gap" social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man

programme.title: Paperman
programme.desc: George meets Meg during his commute and is smitten. He sees her again and tries creative ways to get her attention using only his imagination and papers. This is a heartwarming Disney story.

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair
programme.desc: Budderball is most excited about the food at the town fair: cotton candy, popcorn, peanuts-it all sounds so delicious! When the hungry pup stumbles upon a pie-eating contest.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Home Stinky Home
programme.desc: To save a cute little alien, Lilo and Stitch have to find him a new home. There's just one problem: the alien smells awful! Who will they find to take him in if he stinks up everyplace he goes?

programme.title: Hauntley Girls
programme.desc: Vampirina and her mom start a book club. The first book is magical and spells the humans. They work hard to break the spell. Will they succeed?

programme.title: A Day To Remember
programme.desc: Elena loves celebrating Dia de los Muertos-The Day of the Dead-in Avalor. It's a day of remembrance to honor and celebrate her ancestors.

programme.title: Take Your Pet To The Vet
programme.desc: Doc's hamster, Coleslaw, needs a checkup. But there's one problem . . . Coleslaw isn't a toy, so it's time to take this pet to the vet! .

programme.title: Meet Blondie And Berry
programme.desc: Meet Blondie, a pony with royal aspirations, and Berry, a food-loving bunny, as they form unexpected friendships with Rapunzel and Snow White in enchanting adventures.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Cinderella's classic talebrings the timeless story of Cinderella to life! She meets the prince of her dreams, her Fairy Godmother, and dances at the royal ball.

programme.title: Cloud Country
programme.desc: Sitting there, among the clouds, looking down and day dreaming is... a little cloudlet. Gale would like nothing more than to make one real cloud shape. But instead, she creates something different.

programme.title: Babysitter Bunga
programme.desc: Bunga becomes the unorthodox babysitter in the Pride Lands, teaching kids how to defend themselves. Follow the narration as they use his lessons to fight off the jackals!

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.title: Secret Agent Mater
programme.desc: Mater is a spy car and he has been instructed to catch bad cars! Follow along with word-for-word narration to see what spy life is like for Mater and his friends.

programme.title: Super Spies
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest in DisneyPixar Cars 2.

programme.title: The Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Minnie's Surprise
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy are hired to babysit Clara Cluck's egg, but it begins to hatch on their watch! Follow as the Happy Helpers try to get the mama hen and her egg back together in time.

programme.title: Race For The Rigatoni Ribbon
programme.desc: Mickey and the gang head to Italy to compete in the Race for the Rigatoni Ribbon. Do the Roadster Racers have a chance at winning the race? Follow along with word-for-word narration to find out!

programme.title: A Hot-Dog Day
programme.desc: When Minnie plans a picnic for Daisy and friends, they all pitch in with the help of a misplaced basket.

programme.title: Minnie-rella
programme.desc: The fairy tale is based on the story of Cindrella. Minnie Mouse falls asleep while doing chores and dreams that she becomes Minnierella! She needs help to get ready for Prince Mickey's Grand Ball.

programme.title: Colors All Around
programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gane as they search for their favorite colors. Follow along with word-for-word narration and help them find all the colors in the rainbow!

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem
programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Frozen 2: Welcome Home
programme.desc: Lieutenant Mattias returns to Arendelle after a long absence. Anna shows him around, revealing how much the kingdom has changed. He realizes that home is the best place to be.

programme.title: Outside My Window
programme.desc: For all her life, Rapunzel has been locked inside a tower. She has just one wish on her 18th birthday is to venture out of her tower to see the floating lights! Find out if her wish will come true!

programme.title: Simply Sadness
programme.desc: Inside Riley's mind, Joy and Sadness clash at Headquarters. This chronicles the effort of the five emotions to help Riley thrive.

programme.title: Boo To You, Winnie The Pooh
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Meet Treasure And Sultan
programme.desc: Disney Princesses love animals! Meet Pumpkin, Cinderella's glamorous puppy, and Bayou, Tiana's homesick pony. Discover their stories of friendship and adventure in this charming book.

programme.title: Quest For The Heart
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Moana and Maui set out on an important voyage. Can they work together? Follow along with the word for word narration to find out!

programme.title: One Amazing Chef
programme.desc: Remy, a rat with a flair for cooking, pairs up with young klutz named Linguini to make him a star chef. Follow along as Remy and Linguini work together to make the best food in Paris!

programme.title: Adventure at Skull Rock
programme.desc: Tinker Bell and her fairy friends embark on an adventure to retrieve the stolen Blue Pixie Dust from pirates in this Disney Fairies storybook. Follow the narration!

programme.title: Mowgli's Rainy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Mowgli loves life in the Jungle. He gets to swing from trees, run through tall grass, and swim in rivers. He has many friends, wolf cubs, flying squirrels, and the rhinos.

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: CRIME FILES

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: When Opposites Attract: A Monsoon Romance
programme.desc: This romantic short film portrays a classic "opposites attract" love story between Karan, an engineer focused on logic, and Isha, a compassionate doctor. Their worlds collide during health checkups, leading to a sweet romance that blossoms amidst the monsoon, highlighting how their contrasting personalities connect.

programme.title: Girls Trip Ki Permission
programme.desc: Asking for “just one small trip” turns into logistics, calls, excuses, and dramatic parental negotiations—as the girls try to sneak out but end up doing it all out in the open.

programme.title: Things That Give You Mini Heart Attacks Part 2
programme.desc: Those tiny moments that make your heart skip: phone wakes up by itself in the night, weird app notification while you’re alone, “did-I-just-send-that?” mistakes—little jolts of panic we all experience.

programme.title: Reality Of An Overachiever
programme.desc: What looks like constant success and sparkle on the outside hides the pressure, burnout, self-doubt and never-ending “what-next” questions that come with being the high-achiever everyone expects so much from.

programme.title: When A Love Marriage Becomes Arranged
programme.desc: They fell in love the modern way, but then the families stepped in—and suddenly what was spontaneous turns into “official” with rituals, expectations and relatives.

programme.title: Unexpected Awkward Moments After An Arranged Marriage
programme.desc: Arranged marriages are supposed to be all romantic and smooth, right? Well, not exactly. After the ""yes"", the real fun begins! From awkward silences to ""ab kya baat karen?"" moments, ice-breaking feels like the hardest task on earth!

programme.title: Reality Of A Neet Aspirant
programme.desc: This sketch humorously and relatably dives into the life of a NEET aspirant, showcasing the emotional rollercoaster of anxiety, last-minute revisions, and unsolicited advice from relatives. It highlights the pressure, panic, and unique struggles faced by students preparing for one of India's toughest exams.

programme.title: Reality Of Being A Teacher
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of teaching: the lesson planning, parent-teacher meetings, juggling different learners, fatigue, small wins, big hopes—more real than the “glamour” you think teachers have.

programme.title: If Mother-In-Law Could Hear Your Thoughts | Part 2
programme.desc: The chaos continues as unspoken thoughts once again spill out, turning every polite exchange between mom-in-law and daughter-in-law into hilarious honesty.

programme.title: If Mom-In-Law Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A comical imagining of a daughter-in-law’s inner monologue being heard by her mother-in-law — where politeness meets pure panic.

programme.title: Fashion Conversations With Your Bff
programme.desc: A lighthearted glimpse into how best friends hype, roast, and brutally critique each other’s outfit choices while pretending to be fashion experts.

programme.title: Filtercopy Talkies | The Call Of Duty (independence Day Special)
If You Acted Like Harry Potter Characters In Real Life
programme.desc: A parody imagining how Hogwarts characters’ quirks would play out in normal, everyday situations.

programme.title: Awkward Moments With Parents
programme.desc: This video comically portrays the various awkward situations that arise between young adults and their parents. It highlights relatable moments of parental overprotectiveness, unintentional embarrassments, and the generational gap in understanding.

programme.title: Indian Parents During Winters
programme.desc: From “put on more clothes” to the thermostat wars, random health advice and the dramatic shift in household routines—winter reveals a whole new set of parent-modes.

programme.title: Things Girl Roommates Do
programme.desc: Two (or more) female roommates navigate shared spaces, stealing each other’s snacks, borrowing clothes, gossip sessions and midnight chats. The video captures both the chaos and comfort of living with a girl-friend as a roomie.

programme.title: Life Of A Working Mother
programme.desc: The video portrays the challenges of balancing work and motherhood. It highlights her multitasking, sacrifices, and the love that drives her daily life.

programme.title: Moms During Board Exams
programme.desc: The dramatic shift a mom undergoes when her kid has board exams – transforming into a coach, counselor, cook, motivator, and sometimes panic-stricken overseer. Every worry, prayer, and pep talk is amplified in those days.

programme.title: Things You Shouldn't Say To Your Partner
programme.desc: Funny, awkward and borderline-dangerous phrases that one says to a partner (often unintentionally) that trigger eye-rolls, fights or long silences. The video shows how what we say matters — even when we don’t intend.

programme.title: Every Wedding Prep Ever (aka Shaadi Ki Taiyari)
programme.desc: Indian wedding planning is a tornado of outfit stress, nosy relatives, budget nightmares, and endless last-minute drama—all under one roof.

programme.title: Siblings: Expectation Vs Reality
programme.desc: What you want from your sibling (support and affection) rarely matches what you get (teasing, stealing food, and dramatic arguments). Yet somehow, love peeks through the chaos.

programme.title: When You Date A Malayali
programme.desc: This video humorously explores the distinctive characteristics and experiences of dating a Malayali individual. It highlights their cultural pride, love for Malayalam cinema and unique expressions, all in a comical and relatable manner.

programme.title: Signs That She Is The One
programme.desc: The video highlights the little signs that show yur partner is the one for you. It showcases sweet gestures, understanding, and moments of connection that make a relationship feel perfect.

programme.title: Struggles Of People With Pcod / Pcos
programme.desc: A candid, humorous look at the daily frustrations, symptoms, and misconceptions people with PCOD/PCOS face.

programme.title: Little Ways To Say I Love You (valentine's Day Special)
programme.desc: Tiny, everyday gestures that speak volumes — surprise breakfast, a handwritten note, a random hug — reminding us romance isn’t always big gestures. The video paints Valentine’s Day not just as one grand move but many small ones.

programme.title: Secret Romance
programme.desc: The thrill of hiding your love: quick texts, hushed meet-ups, the adrenaline of being “not obvious,” and the worry that your friends (or worse, parents) might accidentally spill everything.

programme.title: Reality Of Being A New Mom
programme.desc: The video follows Ishani, who enters motherhood with a Pinterest-perfect plan, only to be hit by the hilariously chaotic reality of a newborn. Through a series of quick-cut "Before vs. After" moments, we see her transition from a woman who had time for 10-step skincare routines to someone who considers "dry shampoo and a clean burp cloth" a luxury.

programme.title: When You Move To A New School
programme.desc: You walk into a new campus, new faces, that first lunch break all alone, trying to find your clique, dread of “where do I sit?”, the hope that maybe this one will be better.

programme.title: When Opposites Fall In Love
programme.desc: The introvert meets extrovert love story—proof that sometimes total opposites make the most perfect match.

programme.title: When Your Younger Sibling Is Excited For Diwali
programme.desc: This video comically portrays the overwhelming excitement of a younger sibling for Diwali, contrasting it with the older sibling's more subdued reactions. It highlights the preparations, decorations, and anticipation for the festival through their contrasting perspectives.

programme.title: Childhood Memories We'll Never Forget
programme.desc: This Children's Day special video highlights the cherished and relatable childhood memories that individuals hold dear. It showcases heartwarming moments such as learning to spell, enjoying imaginary boat rides, and the innocent joys of growing up.

programme.title: When You Live To Eat
programme.desc: A tribute to every foodie who plans their day, mood, and relationships around food.

programme.title: If You Could Build Your Partner
programme.desc: he video humorously explores the concept of having a "perfect partner" that can be designed to cater to all your needs, from knowing your moods to always being available. It highlights the imagined benefits and eventual drawbacks of such a relationship

programme.title: Neighborhood Romance
programme.desc: The video humorously depicts the charm and awkwardness of a budding neighbourhood romance. It highlights shy glances, small gestures, and the playful moments that make a neighbourhood romance feel sweet and relatable.

programme.title: Elder Sister Vs. Younger Sister
programme.desc: A more nuanced look into the “big sis vs little sis” world: one is protective, the other wants freedom; one sets rules, the other finds ways around them—but both can’t live without each other.

programme.title: Every Arranged Love Story
programme.desc: The video humorously depicts the initial awkwardness and eventual blossoming of love in an arranged marriage setting. It showcases the couple's journey from their first meeting to gradually understanding and falling for each other, highlighting the challenges and cute moments along the way

programme.title: Every Sister Should Have A Brother Like Him
programme.desc: A brother who’s protective, fun, annoying, helpful — the kind you’d pick if you could choose. The video highlights the ideal (funny-ideal) brother that makes sisterhood richer.

programme.title: Other People Vs Gujaratis
programme.desc: Stereotypes, pride, and amusing exaggerations around Gujarati culture — how “outsiders” see Gujaratis vs how Gujaratis see themselves. The video plays with accents, food, shopping habits, and family dynamics.

programme.title: Every School Romance
programme.desc: The video captures the innocent, awkward, and heartwarming moments of school romances. It highlights the shy glances, small gestures, and playful memories that make young love so special.

programme.title: College Ke Aakhri Din
programme.desc: The video captures the bittersweet emotions of the last day of college. It highlights the nostalgia, friendships, and heartfelt goodbyes that make this milestone unforgettable.

programme.title: When You Think Everything Is A Sign
programme.desc: You find meaning in random coincidences: the phone rings right when you were thinking of someone, the song you disliked plays, you see an old number—so you start believing the universe is “talking” to you.

programme.title: Every Men's Haircut Ever
programme.desc: From insisting on “just a trim” to miraculously gaining ten inches of hair, this video pokes fun at the clichés every guy goes through at the salon. It captures the disconnect between what men ask for and what they actually get.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is Older Than You
programme.desc: The dynamic of having a bestie who’s your mentor, life coach, and chaos partner rolled into one.

programme.title: Story Of Every Average Student
programme.desc: A heartfelt and humorous take on school life for the “average” student: not top of the class, not bottom either—just navigating expectations, grades, fun and the invisible stress of staying “good enough”.

programme.title: Things Single Women Have To Deal With
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the everyday struggles single women face. It highlights societal questions, unwanted advice, and the funny situations that come with being single.

programme.title: When Your Bff Gets Dumped
programme.desc: A relatable take on post-breakup friendship — from emotional support and venting sessions to plotting revenge and ice cream-fueled pep talks.

programme.title: Things Fathers Do (father's Day Special)
programme.desc: A heartfelt yet funny look at the quirks, silent sacrifices and the unspoken ways fathers show up — from fixing things to just being there. The video celebrates dads in their unique, often unnoticed style.

programme.title: Why Grandparents Are The Best
programme.desc: From secret treats to bedtime stories and unconditional love, this one’s a warm hug in video form.

programme.title: Savage Comebacks Every Bride Needs
programme.desc: A newly-wed bride’s toolkit of witty one-liners and bold responses for those aunties, uncles and relatives. The video plays up the idea of being classy but savage when family dramas hit.

programme.title: When You Don't Like Socialising
programme.desc: The introvert’s anthem—dodging parties, small talk, and pretending to be busy when someone says “Let’s hang out!”

programme.title: Sibling Wars Badi Behen Vs Choti Behen
programme.desc: The older-sister vs younger-sister saga: authority battles, petty fights, secret changing-room bans, and a surprising amount of caring behind the theatrics.

programme.title: If You Could Hear Your Crush's Thoughts
programme.desc: This video comically explores the scenarios that unfold if you could hear your crush's thoughts. It highlights the internal monologues, often contrasting with their outward actions, providing a humorous look at the anxieties and desires involved in a crush.

programme.title: Wedding Conversations With Mom
programme.desc: Navigating budgets, guest lists, rituals, outfit choices and mom’s expectations: every exchange becomes a mini-negotiation. The video showcases the wait, the stress, and the sweet chaos of wedding-planning talks with mom.

programme.title: If You Worked In Office Like You Work From Home
programme.desc: The video imagines how chaotic and unprofessional it would be if people behaved in an office the same way they do while working from home. It highlights the funny contrasts between remote work habits and real office etiquette.

programme.title: Filtercopy | Nani Ka Ghar | नानी का घर
programme.desc: A warm nostalgic trip to Grandma’s house—endless food, pampering, cousins, and that special comfort you can’t find anywhere else.

programme.title: When Your Best Friend Leaves Office
programme.desc: When your office buddy moves on: the swap from daily gossip sessions and lunch-huddles to suddenly being solo, and the quiet realisation of how much they held up your workday.

programme.title: Lockdown: Beginning Vs Now
programme.desc: The shift from “I’ll be productive” optimism to pajama-all-day acceptance—lockdown fatigue captured hilariously.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is A Lifesaver
programme.desc: When your best friend swoops in exactly when you need them: the back-up plan for when everything else fails, the one who holds the umbrella when you forgot yours.

programme.title: Holi Na Milegi Dobara

programme.title: Mangal Aarti ISKCON Vrindavan
programme.desc: A daily morning devotional ceremony from ISKCON's Vrindavan temple featuring traditional aarti, kirtan, and sacred hymns led by temple priests and devotees to invoke spiritual blessings.

programme.title: Mangal Aarti ISKCON Chowpatty
programme.desc: A morning devotional ceremony from ISKCON Chowpatty featuring traditional aarti rituals, Sanskrit chants, and congregational singing led by temple priests. The program offers viewers a serene devotional experience with bhajans and ritual music central to Gaudiya Vaishnavism.

programme.title: Tulsi Aarti & Japa
programme.desc: A daily devotional program from Hare Krsna Channel offering traditional Tulsi aarti followed by guided japa chanting of the Hare Krishna mantra to support meditation and bhakti practice. Suitable for viewers seeking peaceful devotional music and spiritual guidance.

programme.title: Sri Narasimha Mantra Dhyan
programme.desc: A guided devotional session featuring the Narasimha mantra with sustained chanting and gentle instrumental backing to support focused meditation and inner calm. Designed for practitioners and newcomers seeking a devotional mantra practice rooted in traditional Sanskrit recitation.

programme.title: Gita Paath
programme.desc: A program of Bhagavad Gita recitations presented with traditional Sanskrit chanting accompanied by short translations and explanations; designed to support devotional study and understanding for general audiences.

programme.title: Sringar Aarti ISKCON Juhu
programme.desc: A daily devotional ceremony featuring the traditional Sringar Aarti performed at the ISKCON Juhu temple, combining melodic kirtan and deity worship. The program offers serene devotional music and brief spiritual reflections suitable for devotees and general audiences.

programme.title: Karma Yog
programme.desc: A devotional series that explains the philosophy and practice of karma yoga within Krishna consciousness, offering practical guidance, scriptural insights, and devotional examples to help viewers cultivate selfless action in daily life.

programme.title: Dham Yatra
programme.desc: A devotional travel series following pilgrims visiting India's sacred Vaishnava sites, exploring temple histories, rituals, and local traditions. Presented by Hare Krsna Channel, the show blends on-location footage, interviews, and devotional music to bring spiritual journeys to life.

programme.title: Bhakti Madhuri
programme.desc: A devotional music program showcasing soulful kirtans and bhajans from the Hare Krsna tradition, featuring traditional chants and melodic renditions to inspire devotion and meditation. programme.title: Gita Ke Anmol Vachan
programme.desc: A devotional program highlighting selected verses and practical teachings from the Bhagavad Gita. Each episode offers simple explanations and reflections to help viewers apply these timeless messages in everyday life.

programme.title: Kirtan Ke Rang Bhakto Ke Sang
programme.desc: A soul-stirring hour of traditional Hare Krishna kirtans and bhajans led by devotional singers, blending Sanskrit chants and regional bhakti songs. The program invites listeners to chant, reflect, and connect with Krishna through melodic call-and-response singing.

programme.title: Jivanopayogi Sikshayen
programme.desc: A weekly spiritual program offering practical bhakti teachings and guidance from the Hare Krishna tradition to help viewers apply devotional principles in daily life. Episodes include scripture explanations, chanting practices, and tips for integrating kindness, discipline, and mindfulness into everyday routines.

programme.title: Katha Sagar

programme.title: Chaahat Ek Nasha
programme.desc: Rashmi, an aspiring singer, idolises a pop sensation, Mallika, who once dated Rahul, the owner of RK Music. Later, Rashmi and Rahul fall in love with each other but Mallika is unable to accept this.

programme.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programme.desc: A group of young Indian men calling themselves Band of Boys decide to perform publicly, to share their talents India-wide, as well as to make a career for themselves. It seems the public is only interested seeing a group of girls perform.

programme.title: Gandhi My Father
programme.desc: The turbulent and troubled life of Gandhi's son, Harilal, who at once tried to support his father's ideology, while simultaneously trying to create a life for himself, separate from his family name.

programme.title: Lucky-No Time For Love
programme.desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

programme.title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
programme.desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.

programme.title: Gaban
programme.desc: An unemployed son of an honest clerk tries to use his charm to con his way to a better life.

programme.title: Khoon Ka Karz
programme.desc: Two young friends are raised in the same orphanage by an affectionate warden. Although they promise her not to stray, fate makes them the biggest gangsters in town. Will she be able to save them now?

programme.title: Aao Pyar Karein
programme.desc: When the times comes for a wealthy man to marry, his parents find a suitable match, but he goes against their wishes and marries a woman from a poor family. He moves out of his palatial family home and goes to live with his wife.

programme.title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
programme.desc: Mala is a poor girl who marries into a wealthy family at the behest of a patriarch. However, after his death, she must deal with abusive relatives and yet strive to restore harmony in the family.

programme.title: Numbri Aadmi
programme.desc: Numbri Aadmi is the story of an unknown Robinhood character who helps the poor and honest when they are threatened and harassed by powerful, ruthless and corrupt people. People call him as Numbri Aadmi, but they are unable to trace him, even though he lives among them.

programme.title: Disco Dancer
programme.desc: Bring back the flashy disco vibes with this sensational Disco Dancer jukebox. Whether you're a retro lover or a new-age dancer, these beats will keep you moving!

programme.title: Gane Naye Purane
programme.desc: Relive the golden era of music with classic melodies, retro rhythms, and timeless tunes that never fade. A nostalgic trip for true old-school lovers!

programme.title: Kumar Sanu Alka Yagnik
programme.desc: Fall in love all over again with Kumar Sanu & Alka Yagnik! Their magical duets—full of passion, heartbreak, and nostalgia—are pure 90s gold.

programme.title: R D Burman – Musical Maverick
programme.desc: A powerhouse collection of R.D. Burman's iconic hits, blending innovation, emotion, and energy. From soulful ballads to electrifying grooves, experience the genius of Pancham Da that defined Bollywood's golden soundscape.

programme.title: Best Of 70s – The Golden Era
programme.desc: Step into Bollywood’s most soulful decade with this jukebox of evergreen melodies. A rich tapestry of romance, innocence, and timeless charm – pure nostalgia from the golden 70s.

programme.title: Best Of 90s – Filmy Beats Reloaded
programme.desc: Take a ride through the vibrant 90s with peppy love anthems, dramatic duets, and emotional melodies. This jukebox celebrates the signature style of Bollywood's musical revival decade.

programme.title: Rajesh Khanna – The Superstar's Anthems
programme.desc: Revisit the unmatched charm of Rajesh Khanna with this jukebox of unforgettable melodies. Romantic, philosophical, and heartfelt – these songs defined an era and a superstar.

programme.title: Scooter
programme.desc: Aniket an entrepreneur is in his hometown, coming after a very long time. Trying to sell his father's home. After spending few hours in that house he goes back into his childhood memories. Aniket as a young boy was very stubborn. This time he was stuck up on a car. Like his many friends, he also wanted to have a car for his family, instead, his father buys a Scooter. He feels very humiliated and refuses to go by it. The story portrays a basic 90s FatherSon relationship

programme.title: Live A Little Part 2
programme.desc: After 5 years, Nimisha and Atish meet again at a party. She is awarded Best Emerging Entrepreneur by none other than Atish. Atish couldn't let another day go by without confronting Nimisha. Both seem happy and has moved on in their lives until they realize they've been living in a delusion. They reminded each other of their Pact which was made 5 years ago. Live a Little . Then made sudden plans which led to unexpected confessions which led to the most memorable night of their lives.

programme.title: Prison

programme.title: Pintu
